evidence: Plan: 'fit_outbound→fit_markdown_to_adf_limit (the old fit_text_to_adf_limit measured the plain encode… so it must be repointed)'
Existing test not in the plan's update list: test_fit_is_idempotent (test_rich_text_codec.py:123) parametrized over AdfCodec asserts codec.fit_outbound(once) == once

Truncating Markdown SOURCE text mid-construct (mid-fence, mid-emphasis, mid-list-marker) can change how markdown_to_adf parses the truncated prefix, so a naive binary-search-on-source fit may not be its own fixed point.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Qualify the idempotence claim to the measured ≥99.6% and state how the ~0.35% non-idempotent-but-error-free tail is bounded (e.g. detected and degraded, or explicitly documented as a residual the downstream state-based echo layer in 3388 must absorb).
evidence: Approach §4: 'Keep normalize_outbound as the idempotent reads-after-round-trip transform'
AC: 'round-trip is idempotent … for ≥99.6% of the 5,730 live-store bodies (measured 99.65%)' — i.e. ~0.35% are NOT idempotent
Approach §5 degrade trigger is 'any conversion error for a field' — a non-idempotent-but-error-free body raises no error, so it never degrades
findings.finding: The whole-codec degrade fires only on a conversion ERROR, but the plan's own corpus AC concedes ~0.35% of bodies round-trip error-free yet non-idempotently. Approach §4 nonetheless describes normalize_outbound as 'the idempotent reads-after-round-trip transform' — an overclaim, since r(r(x))==r(x) is measured at 99.65%, not 100%, and the ~0.35% non-idempotent-but-error-free tail is not caught by the error-only degrade path.
findings.location: Approach §4 (Loop prevention within the codec) and §5 (Failure path = WHOLE-CODEC degrade)
scenarios: A body in the ~0.35% non-idempotent tail that converts without raising; when 3388 wires normalize_outbound into the compare, it oscillates because r(r(x))!=r(x) and no error triggers the plain fallback
